artifacts.name: a5-icons
artifacts.observation: All 46 icons directly inspected on lime and night. Distinct silhouettes and common mineral fills; Air and arc marks are lighter stroke-based exceptions. Fine glints simplify at 32 px. Heat edge corrected after deterministic rejection. Labels and source status distinguish Water lines from legacy Fire individual spells; local claims of originality are diagnostic, not proof. Owner should assess metaphor fit (including the gauge-like Heat symbol) and small-size recognition.

artifacts.name: a5-hud
artifacts.observation: 1080p and 1440p compositions directly inspected: perimeter panels leave mage, immediate foes and telegraphs open. Larger line/spell labels resolve initial crowding. Mobile reflows below the arena for review only. Background camera and oversized semicircle-like absorb remain unchanged owner candidates; HUD does not correct or approve them. Slot controls are an art preview, not cast or cooldown simulation.

artifacts.name: a5-hud-borrowed
artifacts.observation: Borrowed treatment uses a dashed frame plus explicit text; selected blue bottom rule remains distinct. Cooldown uses shading plus seconds; locked uses desaturation plus label. Borrowed Water sample demonstrates styling only and does not assert a valid cross-school loadout. No arena figures, poses or effects created.
